name: vornik-companion
description: Vornik companion for Cursor (LLD 28): an MCP entry that runs vornikctl's bridge (the key stays in its file), an always-applied rule with Vornik's working rules, the companion skills, and a sessionStart hook that adds your delegations and recent memory to a new chat. Install with vornikctl companion connect cursor, which writes vornikctl's absolute path into mcp.json and hooks.json.
